name: Grounded Evidence Cascade
description: Answer a research question with every claim carrying a live-fetched source anchor and a two-axis (authority x recency) source assessment, never model recall. A claim with zero anchors is emitted as `unresolved`, never as prose. Mechanism: a tool-health preflight census gates the run, lenses fan out one per SOURCE CLASS, each claim is re-checked FACT/RACE-style, then sources are scored on two axes before synthesis.

source_classes.description: One grounded lens is fanned out per source class

max_sources.description: Upper bound on sources reviewed across all lenses

time_horizon.description: Recency floor applied to the recency axis

search_api_key.description: Reference NAME of the search credential. The value never enters an artifact, a log, an export bundle or a replay journal.

preflight-auditor.description: Enumerates the live research MCP inventory and each engine's quota state BEFORE any lens runs; an engine that cannot be shown UP is not used and is recorded as unavailable

question-architect.description: Decomposes the question into one lens per source class, each with a named settling probe; never answers the question itself

grounded-lens.description: Gathers evidence for exactly one source class and must attach a URL or a file:line to every claim it emits

fact-verifier.description: Cross-vendor FACT/RACE re-check: re-derives each claim from the raw fetched artifact, never from a lens summary

source-assessor.description: Scores each surviving source on the two declared axes (authority, recency) and records that this is a MODEL JUDGEMENT, not a measurement

synthesiser.description: Writes the report with an inline confidence band per claim and an `unresolved` section that is never silently dropped

routes.reason: a same-vendor verifier shares the lens author's blind spots

anchor-or-unresolved.expression: claims_without_anchor == 0 AND tool_health_recorded == true AND anchors_from_engines_proven_up == true

stages.title: Census the live research tools and their quota state

work_unit.title: Enumerate live research engines and record each one's UP/DOWN/quota state
work_unit.question_or_target: Produce the engine roster this run may use: for every research MCP in the inventory, record reachable/unreachable and remaining quota, and mark the substitution order a lens must follow when its first engine is exhausted.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: substantive subagents default to Opus (performance rule: quality over cost)

work_unit.evidence_requirement: each engine row carries the exact probe invoked and its verbatim reachability response; an engine with no probe output is recorded unavailable, never assumed UP
tests_required: both-states control: an engine pointed at an unreachable endpoint must be recorded DOWN, and the same engine pointed at its real endpoint must be recorded UP in the same run
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the synthesiser re-reads this roster before accepting any anchor and rejects an anchor from an engine not proven UP
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPR-0101 emitted only when the roster exists, parses, names every engine the lenses will use, and each row carries a probe output; otherwise FAILED:BPR-0101 <failure-class> <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: fixed backoff, at most 2 attempts; a second failure records the engine unavailable rather than retrying a third time

stages.title: Decompose the question into one lens per source class

work_unit.title: Emit the lens plan: one answerable sub-question per source class with a settling probe
work_unit.question_or_target: Turn the question into one sub-question per declared source class, each carrying the probe that would settle it and the engine (from the preflight roster) that will be used.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: substantive subagents default to Opus (performance rule: quality over cost)

work_unit.evidence_requirement: every sub-question names its settling probe and the engine assigned to it from the preflight roster
tests_required: a source class whose every engine is DOWN in the preflight roster must appear in the plan as unservable, not silently dropped
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: one independent reviewer confirms the sub-questions jointly cover the question and none is unanswerable by construction
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPR-0102 emitted only when the plan exists, parses, and has one entry per declared source class; otherwise FAILED:BPR-0102 <failure-class> <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: after two rejected plans, enumerate at least two alternative decompositions before a third attempt

stages.title: Fan out one grounded lens per source class

body.title: Gather anchored evidence for one source class

work_unit.title: Gather and anchor every claim for one source class
work_unit.question_or_target: For the assigned source class, emit claims each carrying a live URL or file:line, the engine that produced it, and the fetch timestamp; a claim you cannot anchor goes to `unresolved`.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: substantive subagents default to Opus (performance rule: quality over cost)

work_unit.evidence_requirement: one URL or file:line per claim plus the engine id and fetch time; an unanchored statement is emitted under `unresolved`, never as prose
tests_required: a question with a known-present anchor must yield that anchor (detector control)
a deliberately unanswerable sub-question must yield mostly `unresolved`, not confident prose
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the cross-vendor fact-verifier re-derives a sample of claims from the raw fetched page, not from this summary
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPR-0103 emitted only when the record exists, parses, and every claim row has either an anchor or an `unresolved` marker; otherwise FAILED:BPR-0103 <failure-class> <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: on a second engine failure switch to the next engine in the preflight substitution order and record the substitution

stages.title: Cross-vendor FACT/RACE re-check of every claim

work_unit.title: Re-derive each claim from its raw source and record CONFIRMED / REFUTED / UNRESOLVED
work_unit.question_or_target: For every claim emitted by the lenses, re-fetch the anchor and decide whether the claim survives its own source. A claim whose anchor does not contain it is REFUTED, not softened.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: cross-vendor verification: an independent vendor has independent failure modes

work_unit.evidence_requirement: per claim: the re-fetched anchor, the quoted span that carries it, and the verdict; a verdict with no quoted span is UNRESOLVED
tests_required: seed one claim that its own anchor does NOT support - the pass must return REFUTED for it and CONFIRMED for an adjacent true claim in the same run
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the synthesiser may not promote a claim this pass left UNRESOLVED
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPR-0104 emitted only when every claim in the lens records has exactly one verdict row carrying a quoted span or an explicit UNRESOLVED reason; otherwise FAILED:BPR-0104 <failure-class> <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: after two severed dispatches, fall back to an in-vendor verifier and record the loss of vendor independence

stages.title: Score every surviving source on the authority and recency axes

work_unit.title: Two-axis source assessment with an explicit judgement disclaimer
work_unit.question_or_target: Score each surviving source on authority and on recency against the declared time_horizon, and record on the artifact that both axes are model judgement rather than measurement.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: substantive subagents default to Opus (performance rule: quality over cost)

work_unit.evidence_requirement: each score cites the property it was derived from (publisher, author, date field) and the artifact states in-band that the axes are judgement, not measurement
tests_required: a source dated outside the declared time_horizon must score low on recency and must not be silently excluded
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: one independent reviewer spot-checks three scores against the source page and records any disagreement
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPR-0105 emitted only when every source in the confirmation record has both axis scores and the judgement disclaimer is present; otherwise FAILED:BPR-0105 <failure-class> <reason>

work_unit.title: Expand one hop from the highest-authority sources and re-anchor anything new
work_unit.question_or_target: From the top-authority sources, follow one hop of citations and emit only sources that add an anchor the existing set does not already carry.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: substantive subagents default to Opus (performance rule: quality over cost)

work_unit.evidence_requirement: each expanded row names the source it was reached from and the anchor it adds; a row adding no new anchor is dropped with that reason recorded
tests_required: a citation set with zero new anchors must produce an empty expansion with the reason recorded, not an empty file
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the synthesiser treats an expanded source as ordinary evidence, subject to the same anchor gate
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPR-0106 emitted only when the expansion exists, parses, and every row names its parent source and its new anchor; otherwise FAILED:BPR-0106 <failure-class> <reason>

stages.title: No claim without an anchor; no anchor from an engine not proven UP
Write the report with an inline confidence band per claim

work_unit.title: Synthesise the anchored answer, the unresolved set, and the tool-health footer
work_unit.question_or_target: Write the report: every claim carries its anchor, its verdict and an inline confidence band; the unresolved set is a first-class section; the footer records which engines were UP and which substitutions happened.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: substantive subagents default to Opus (performance rule: quality over cost)

work_unit.evidence_requirement: every claim row carries anchor + verdict + confidence band inline; the unresolved count is stated numerically in the summary
tests_required: delete one anchor from the confirmation record and the report build must FAIL the anchor gate rather than emit the claim as prose (both-states: restore it and the build passes)
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: one adversarial reviewer in a fresh context who authored none of the lenses checks for claims whose confidence band exceeds their evidence
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPR-0107 emitted only when the report exists, parses, states its unresolved count, and carries the tool-health footer; otherwise FAILED:BPR-0107 <failure-class> <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: after two failed syntheses, emit the partial report plus the blocking reason instead of a third attempt

contraindications: NOT for a question answerable from the repo - use a grounded file:line lens
NOT for a single fact lookup - that is one fetch
NOT when the answer must be deterministically replayable: live web state drifts
x_extensions.replay_note: replay.deterministic is FALSE on purpose: the open web is not replayable. The artifact cache makes a re-run within TTL reproducible, so the cache key is recorded in the report footer instead of a determinism claim.
x_extensions.per_item_path_note: the DSL relative_path grammar forbids brace templating, so a fan-out body declares the canonical per-item record NAME; the runner derives the per-item path from the barrier key_field plus resume.idempotency_key_from item_key.
unverified: UNVERIFIED that this shape beats a bare WebSearch loop on anchors-per-claim; settling experiment = run both on the same five questions and count anchors/claim and unresolved/claim.

params.question: What changed in Claude Code saved Workflows between 2026-06-01 and today?

acceptance: >=8 distinct anchors across the three lenses
the tool-health footer names every engine used

stopping_rule_controls.why: the minimum_conditions floor must block a cheap early stop
a lens adding no new anchor stops the cascade only after three lenses have returned
